name: Delta 800 VDC DC Busway (announced)
description: Row-level DC busway Delta showed at OCP Global Summit 2026 for 800 VDC architectures. Announced only; Delta published no ampere, voltage or kW rating. Values below are placeholders for sizing.

capacity_w.note: no rating published. Estimated as 1000-2500 A (the ampacity band of today's AC AI-row busways, e.g. Starline T5 1200 A, Siemens LData 2500 A) x 800 V two-conductor DC = 0.8-2.0 MW

rating_a.note: assumed equal to AC row busway ampacities (1000-2500 A); no Delta figure

voltage_v.note: Delta: 'efficient power distribution for upcoming 800 VDC architectures'; NVIDIA says 800 VDC carries 85% more power than 415 VAC in the same conductor

sources.title: Delta highlights 800 VDC power and cooling at OCP Global Summit 2026 (PR Newswire, 2026-10-15)
NVIDIA 800 V HVDC architecture will power the next generation of AI factories (NVIDIA Technical Blog, 2025-05-20)
